name: Azlask — +X/+X where X is the number of experience counters you have
notes: Memory: project_experience_poison_counters_2026-05-14. The 'until end of turn' clause between +X/+X and 'where X is' stopped the where-X rewrite, and experience counters on the player were not readable by the for-each count. With 3 experience counters, firing Azlask's pump makes Grizzly Bears 5/5 (and Azlask 5/5). The ability pseudo-permanent is added directly with addActivatedAbility (ability index 1).

call: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of experience counters you have. Scions and Spawns you control gain indestructible and annihilator 1 until end of turn.

{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of experience counters you have. Scions and Spawns you control gain indestructible and annihilator 1 until end of turn.
